mods.name: Tim (Trail Investigator Module)
mods.description: A Meteor Client addon built with AI featuring a handful of utilities for hunting.

releases.notes:
Tim 1.2 (Trail Investigator Module) is a comprehensive multi-version Meteor Client utility and base-hunting addon fully compatible across Minecraft 1.21.4 to 1.21.11. + 26.1.

Inventory 101: *Pixel-perfect container centering, new item glows for shulkers, and a one-click "Drop All" button that protects your inventory and ender chests.*

Smarter HUDs: *Loot Lens and Eight To One now track chests and portals cleanly without turning on extra highlights or automation.*

Real Ping Tracking: *Statistics HUD and Time Throttle now measure your true server ping instead of tab-list latency.*

Skipper Updates: *Automatically drops temporary Xaero minimap waypoints in the Nether for skipped portals.*

Baromine Fixes: *Major reliability fixes for water safety, inventory recovery, and block placement.*

Threaturn Privacy: *You can now choose to keep your disconnect coordinates Visible, Censored, or Hidden in messages and warning logs.*

Timmy Icon Refresh: *Smoother, optimized icons alongside a new configurable idle daydream animation with sound.*

Ahoy (New Module): *Ahoy automates fishing with smart recasting, rod management, catch filters, storage, goals, alerts, and safety checks, while protecting existing inventory and accommodating hopper collection reliably.*
